headline: Production database is now internet-accessible with no enforcement that this is temporary
suppressed: Storage is unencrypted, but this appears pre-existing and outside the scope of this change.

findings.evidence_ref: publicly_accessible changed from false to true in data_stores.tf
findings.explanation: The production PostgreSQL database is now reachable from the internet. Even with the security group, any misconfiguration or credential leak exposes production data directly to external attack.

findings.evidence_ref: PR description says 'while we work out VPC peering' but no deadline, TODO comment, or code to enforce reversion
findings.explanation: There is no mechanism to ensure this temporary access actually gets reverted. Once merged, there is nothing preventing this from staying public indefinitely.
